description:
Returns the keys of all properties for a dashboard item.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** The user must have read permission of the dashboard or have the dashboard shared with them.

parameters.description: The ID of the dashboard item.
parameters.name: itemId

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description: Returned if the dashboard or dashboard item is not found, or the dashboard is not owned by or shared with the user.
